title: Automation Rotation Watcher — Design Plan (No Implementation)

remainingForImplementation: Compressed-context signal from Codex environment API
Rotation watcher integration into factoryctl watch command
designPlan.whyAlertNotPass: Alerts detect signals; only verifiers gate phase transitions. Alert != PASS prevents false automation-driven advancement.
designPlan.noMutation: Watcher reads state only. Never writes governance state, never advances phase, never creates handoff.
designPlan.reportingMechanism: Read-only alert via monitoring output. Alert is NOT a verifier PASS.
designPlan.rotationRecommendation: If handoff is > 24h stale or phase is stale without recent verification, recommend manual session rotation + startup verification.
